name: remarkable-ink-round-trip
description: reMarkable Ink Round-Trip for Obsidian — notes kept in two-way sync with your reMarkable as real pen strokes (a single-line font or your own handwriting): what you erase, move, mark or write on the tablet is merged back into the note. Fork of reMarkable Round-Trip.

scripts.build: tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/check-bundle.mjs
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
